packageRules.description: Wheels are built for exactly these CPython versions (pyproject.toml [tool.cibuildwheel]); a new cibuildwheel major can change the default build set and manylinux images, so a person checks the wheel matrix.

vcpkg.json builtin-baseline pins every native dependency in the wheels (FFmpeg, libsndfile, rubberband...), so moving it changes what ships. A person reviews it, and checks whether the rubberband overlay port in vcpkg-ports/ can be deleted (see its README). Baseline commits carry no release timestamp, so the preset's release-age wait would hold them forever.
